keyFindings.text: SUBJECT_RE allows 13 types with lowercase kebab scope; numeric-only scopes block; summary rules block lowercase/space/punct/vague; >100 chars blocks; process labels warn.
TRAILER_RE is a closed whitelist; new keys (Spec/Phase/Commit-Id) count as explanatory body and a machine line satisfies the >=4-path body gate.
The hook is active machine-wide via global core.hooksPath symlinked to the main clone's hook sources; install writes symlinks only.
Live baseline 9,108->9,112 commits; 73% SUBJECT_RE match; 1,355 numeric scopes; 2,948 subjects >80 chars; 558 >100.
Co-Authored-By 80.8%, Claude-Session 42.1%, Refs 3.8% (306 spec-path, 0 numeric); bodies 90.1%.
12,718 ten-hex tokens across 1,904 specs markdown files; 31 files elsewhere under .opencode/skills; zero in changelogs/root docs.
--grep matches any message line (case-sensitive, ^ per line, OR default, AND via --all-match); packet AND query = 2 commits; -S/-G = 0 (diffs only).
%(trailers:key=Refs) extracts 119/349; final contiguous paragraph only; keys case-insensitive; Commit-Id already parseable.
Trigger index corpus = specs/.opencode-skills/install-guides docs; research lineages excluded; commits cannot enter without a new pipeline.
All candidate id shapes pass the hook in a final trailer block at zero subject cost; scope placement dies; subject placement contradicts the doc contract.
worktree-naming.sh lock + high-water allocator transfers to commit-id minting; no back-fill; ceiling.
413 duplicated subjects covering 1,002 commits: message identity is not unique; copy operations duplicate embedded ids unless policy handles it.
Canonical shape: Context/Changes/Verification prose + final block Spec/Phase/Commit-Id/Refs; placement law enforced by interpret-trailers behavior.
Spec: appears in 81 commits but only 2 extract; placement outside the final paragraph is why.
Body norm: median 101 words, mean 121.5; target <=120 words, Context <=40.
Gerrit stamps message-embedded ids that survive rewrites - mechanism transfers; review semantics and duplicate-on-copy do not.
Retrofit cascade: 297 refs + 65 spec + 719 scope-dir + 4,250 unique-touch + 705 dominant = 6,036 mapped; 3,075 fallback (41 ties, 310 scope-only, 2,724 no-signal).
Scope-only mapping is ambiguous: of 310 scope-only commits, 52 resolve to one track; number 80 spans 13 tracks.
Live drift: 9,108->9,112 commits during the session; pin SHA and stop writers for the rewrite window.
filter-repo: stream rewrite; prunes reflogs/objects; fresh-clone abort; commit-map old/new cumulative; signatures+extended headers stripped; message-callback also hits tag messages.
notes/replace are not fetched/pushed by default, not message-searchable, not rendered by GitHub - rejected as id carriers.
Citation corpus reduces to 1,700 commit-prefix tokens + 294 full-SHA cites in 7,260 unique; 5,560 decoys; token 1e58d845af x4,287; zero 10-hex collisions.
460 commit messages cite 551 hex tokens; not remappable in the first rewrite pass.
Blast radius: 60 branches, 28 worktrees (2 prunable), 149 tags (98 annotated), 8 origin refs, 2 dependabot; live-sync must be stopped and reset; main/skilled force-push pre-push-exempt.
Enforcement: extend TRAILER_RE; repo-identity-aware prepare-commit-msg stamper; allocator reuse; tests are the gap; five doc surfaces.
Phase plan 002 contract freeze -> 003 forward tooling -> 004 mapping -> 005 rewrite execution -> 006 convergence, each with a gate.
